title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
title_zh: World Tracing：超越可见区域的生成式像素对齐几何
abstract_en: Image-to-3D methods often trade off faithfulness and completeness: depth estimators are anchored to input pixels but stop at the visible surface, while image-to-3D models generate complete shapes that are often misaligned with the input. We introduce World Tracing, a generative pixel-aligned geometry representation that predicts 3D points aligned with observed pixels while completing geometry beyond the visible surface. For each input pixel, World Tracing predicts an ordered stack of camera-space 3D points, where the first layer represents the visible surface and subsequent layers represent front-to-back intersections with occluded surfaces. We instantiate this representation with a world-tracing diffusion transformer, WT-DiT, which treats multiple geometry layers as separate denoising tokens coupled through factorized and global attention. WT-DiT is trained with pixel-space flow matching and a mixed noise schedule that balances visible-surface reconstruction with occluded-geometry generation. World Tracing achieves strong performance on visible-surface reconstruction and complete geometry generation across object, scene, and dynamic benchmarks, outperforming both depth predictors and image-to-3D generators. It also preserves 2D-to-3D correspondence, enabling text-driven 3D scene editing, geometry-conditioned novel-view video synthesis, and training-free integration with textured-mesh generators.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 World Tracing，一种生成式像素对齐几何表示，旨在缓解 Image-to-3D 方法中“可见表面忠实但不完整”与“完整形状生成但与输入错位”的矛盾。该方法为每个输入像素预测一组有序的相机空间 3D 点栈：第一层对应可见表面，后续层表示从前到后与被遮挡表面的交点。作者进一步提出 world-tracing diffusion transformer（WT-DiT），将多层几何视为独立去噪 token，并通过因子化注意力与全局注意力建模层间关系。WT-DiT 采用像素空间 flow matching 和混合噪声调度，在可见表面重建与遮挡几何生成之间取得平衡。实验表明，World Tracing 在物体、场景和动态基准上同时提升可见表面重建与完整几何生成能力，优于深度估计器和 Image-to-3D 生成器，并保留 2D-to-3D 对应关系，可用于文本驱动 3D 场景编辑、几何条件新视角视频合成，以及与纹理网格生成器的免训练集成。
key_points_zh: 提出 World Tracing 表示：每个像素对应一个有序 3D 点栈，首层为可见表面，后续层补全被遮挡几何。
提出 WT-DiT，将多层几何作为去噪 token，通过因子化注意力和全局注意力建模跨层与全局结构。
训练采用像素空间 flow matching 与混合噪声调度，兼顾可见表面精确重建和不可见几何的生成能力。
在物体、场景和动态基准上优于传统 depth predictors 与 Image-to-3D generators，兼具对齐性与完整性。
保留 2D-to-3D correspondence，可支持文本驱动 3D 编辑、几何条件 novel-view video synthesis 和与 textured-mesh generators 的免训练结合。

llm_assessment.comment: World Tracing introduces a compelling pixel-aligned multilayer geometry representation that could meaningfully influence image-to-3D reconstruction and completion.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: World Tracing提出了有吸引力的像素对齐多层几何表示，可能显著影响图像到三维的重建与补全研究。
